items.title: Story Garden
items.subject: English reading
items.objective: Identify a story character, setting, problem and ending; explain a setting with an example.
items.nationalContext: Qatar foundation-language and communication goals are broadly relevant, but exact Qatar Grade 1-2 outcome not verified.
items.internationalTopic: Year 1-2 reading comprehension, stories and discussion
items.risk: Not a complete reading scheme; English phonics requires separate sequenced instruction.
items.location: feature branch PR #28; adult review staging only

items.title: Number Tree
items.subject: Mathematics
items.objective: Represent 34 as three groups of ten and four ones using accurate dot models.
items.nationalContext: General numeracy and practical learning principles; exact school-unit sequence requires Qatar textbook and teacher check.
items.internationalTopic: England Year 2: two-digit place value; concrete objects and pictures
items.risk: Verify accessibility of dot groupings and digits and do not confuse UK Year 2 with Qatar Grade 2.
items.location: feature branch PR #28; adult review staging only

items.title: Fraction Flowers
items.subject: Mathematics
items.objective: Interpret 3/4 as three of four equal-sized parts and identify numerator and denominator.
items.nationalContext: General numeracy principles; current Qatar Grade 3-4 textbook objectives need independent mapping.
items.internationalTopic: England Year 3-4: fractions as equal parts and common diagram representations
items.risk: Require visual equality, native Arabic maths review, multiple model types and conceptual transfer.
items.location: feature branch PR #28; adult review staging only

items.title: Living World
items.subject: Science
items.objective: Describe links among sunlight, plants and selected animals, without claiming all food chains are identical.
items.nationalContext: Qatar national framework supports environment, scientific observation and sustainability, but exact grade objective is pending.
items.internationalTopic: England Year 2 habitats/food chains and KS2 living things; thematic overlap only
items.risk: Current demonstration is a conceptual web, not a complete or precise food-chain diagram; avoid implying every insect pollinates every plant.
items.location: feature branch PR #28; adult review staging only

items.title: Fair Test Lab
items.subject: Science inquiry
items.objective: Identify one independent variable and keep relevant comparison conditions the same.
items.nationalContext: Framework supports investigation, collecting evidence and reasoning; Qatar syllabus document verification outstanding.
items.internationalTopic: England Years 5-6 working scientifically, including recognizing and controlling variables
items.risk: Adult supervision for any future experiments; this draft uses safe thought questions only.
items.location: feature branch PR #28; adult review staging only

items.title: Evidence Detective
items.subject: Reading and digital literacy
items.objective: Distinguish a claim from supporting evidence and select an original trustworthy source.
items.nationalContext: General critical thinking, inquiry, digital citizenship and language principles are relevant; exact Qatar grade objective unverified.
items.internationalTopic: Upper-primary explanation, evidence evaluation and child-centred digital literacy
items.risk: Human-reviewed source examples and careful handling of misinformation needed before adding live links or AI responses.
items.location: feature branch PR #28; adult review staging only
